verdict.rationale: cfo.ai documents two of its own ways to get Model outputs out: a manual Excel download of a Page, and an MCP server through which an agent can read the financial Model. Neither is a warehouse-oriented export or general data API. Snowflake and Postgres appear only as inbound sources, and no OpenAPI spec was found. The MCP server also issues no API keys, since every client signs in as a person through OAuth, which limits unattended pipelines. Missing for 10: a documented REST/data API or scheduled export of metrics, forecasts and scenario results; a warehouse write-back or destination connector; service/API-key auth for automated pipelines; independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can pull model outputs (metrics, forecasts, scenario results) into a warehouse or internal tool through a documented export or API

citations.quote: Download a Page as an Excel workbook that keeps its formulas.
an agent can read a company's financial Model
